_about: Everything on the Studio page. Each product shows only if it has no gate. Claude fills a gate's blank when Josef answers, then clears the gate. Counts on join lists show only at 10 or more. The hero shows only intro. The meta description uses lede_album_gated while the album card is hidden, so it names the album only when the album shows. kind and kicker are kept but not printed (T-16); the page title is the kicker's first part.

products.name: Bird League
products.what: Fantasy sports for birders. Draft real species, then score points against your league each week by finding them in the wild.
products.proof: Build 49 names birds from a photo or a song, and sends sightings to eBird in one tap.
products.image_alt: Then: an early Bird League screen that still says mock data. Now: build 49's life list wall.
